# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 11 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 11 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_011_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 11

**11:1** Mary picked up the water jar and went out to the well. Suddenly a voice rang out: "Greetings, favored one! The Lord is with you! Blessed are you among women!"

**11:2** She spun around, looking left and right — but there was no one. Shaking with fear, she hurried back inside, set down the jar, picked up the purple thread, sat down, and went back to her spinning.

**11:3** Then an angel of the Lord was suddenly standing right in front of her. "Don't be afraid, Mary," the angel said. "You have found favor with the Lord of all creation. You are going to conceive by his word."

**11:4** Mary sat with that for a moment, then thought aloud: "Conceive? By the Lord — the living God? And give birth the way any woman gives birth?"

**11:5** The angel answered: "No, Mary — not like that. The power of the Lord will come over you like a shadow. The holy child to be born from you will be called the Son of the Most High. And you will name him Jesus, because he will rescue his people from their sins."

**11:6** Mary answered quietly: "I am the Lord's servant, standing before him. Let everything happen to me just as you have said."
